    Biology authored deck example

    This valid .neoanki source bundle demonstrates a deck manifest and JSONL item part. The fast test suite validates it with the same Swift validator used by the CLI.

    • deck.jsonl
    • items/cells.jsonl

    Download the files while preserving the Biology.neoanki/items/ directory structure, then run:

    swift run --package-path NeoAnkiCore neoanki-deck validate docs/examples/Biology.neoanki
